description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: new lib/zaq/engine/connect/credential_resolver.ex and resolved_credential.ex, Connect facade, test/zaq/engine/connect/credential_resolver_test.exs and property tests. Public internal boundary resolve_credential(credential_or_id, trusted_actor, opts) reloads persisted credential and uses ActorNormalizer.person_id/1; malformed actor carrying invalid Person identity fails closed rather than becoming org. This API is privileged runtime-only, not a Person-facing read/event action. Canonical lookup uses credential and owner only; no provider/resource fallback and no reads of credential.api_key/private_key as grant sources. Disabled always selects global. Optional Person selects personal row if present, otherwise global. Required Person requires personal row irrespective of global availability. Non-Person selects global for every policy. Select ownership BEFORE checking status: revoked or expired personal row is not absence. Return safe structured reasons personal_credential_required, global_credential_missing, credential_revoked/expired/unavailable with credential_id as appropriate; no global availability in personal errors. ResolvedCredential contains safe dependency identity, auth_kind and redacted ephemeral authentication; generic auth data, never ReqLLM options. Only include consumer-needed secrets; never OAuth client_secret as an accidental runtime grant field. API/JWT usability checks status, timestamp and decryptability. OAuth may invoke existing refresh through the hardened boundary from step 7; until then return explicit expired error rather than fallback. Existing grant kind/config mismatch fails unavailable. Lock/read revision strategy must avoid returning known superseded material after mutation commits; document linearization and future consumer creation-race responsibility.

Tests to add before implementation: generated 2 Actor x 3 policy x 4 personal state x 4 global state = 96 cases (non-Person personal dimension deliberately ignored); assert selected IDs and exact errors. Property tests credential/person isolation, ignored personal state under disabled/non-Person, no fallback on selected grant failure, at most one grant. Test no runtime source from legacy secrets; corrupt ciphertext; wrong credential; stale credential struct; nil Actor privileged global resolution versus denied management; credentials deleted mid-resolution. Re-run OAuth expiration cases after step 7.

Branches/paths validated: missing configuration, incompatible material, all statuses, expires_at boundary with controlled clock, refreshable versus unrefreshable OAuth, non-Person required missing global. Resolution makes no LLM/provider authentication request and no per-request policy mechanism.

Mocking plan: real DB and internal modules; clock/config through existing injectable boundary Zaq.Config, no global mutation; mock external OAuth HTTP only. Documentations to update: API/types/moduledocs, docs/services/engine.md precedence/error table and runtime-only contract. >=95% touched-file coverage.
title: [zaq-jrg] 4. Resolve effective credential independently of consumers
